source.source_name: City of St. Joseph Concession and Restroom Facility Lease RFP
source.rights_notes: Official municipal public record used for local schema validation only. Reuse rights must be confirmed before training or redistribution.
source.governing_law_text: This Lease Agreement shall be construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of Missouri.

evidence.text: City of St. Joseph, Missouri, a Missouri municipal corporation

premises.description: Concession and restroom facility adjacent to the City Park at 7th and Felix.
premises.address: Northwest corner of Felix Street and North 7th Street, St. Joseph, Missouri
premises.permitted_use: Concession stand, restroom facility, public events, and limited private events

evidence.text: The City hereby leases to the Lessee, and the Lessee leases from the City, for the rentals and upon, and subject to, the terms and conditions set forth herein, the Premises near the northwest corner of the intersection of Felix Street and North 7th Street in St. Joseph, Missouri.

clauses.heading: A. Leasehold Grant
clauses.text: Thereafter, this Lease Agreement shall automatically renew annually for an additional one (1) year period, each upon the same terms as stated herein, unless either party notifies the other that it seeks to terminate or otherwise end the Lease Agreement, or the leasehold created herein, at the end of the then-current term.

clauses.heading: B.2 Net Lease
clauses.text: The parties hereto agree that this Lease Agreement is intended to be a net lease, with all payments for taxes, utilities, repairs, maintenance, and insurance related to the Lessee's use and possession of the Premises to be at the sole cost and expense of the Lessee.

clauses.heading: G.11 Assignment and Sublease
clauses.text: The Lessee may not assign, sublease, mortgage, pledge, sell, or in any other manner transfer, convey, or dispose of the Premises or its rights under this Lease Agreement, or any right or interest therein, or part thereof, whether voluntary, involuntary, or by operation of law, without the prior written consent of the City.

clauses.heading: G.12 Repairs, Maintenance, and Cleaning
clauses.text: The Lessee is responsible for any and all repairs, replacement, maintenance, and cleaning to the Premises, including the buildings thereon, and any and all appurtenances to either.

clauses.heading: O. Hazardous Substances
clauses.text: The Lessee agrees not to generate, store, use, treat, or dispose of, nor to allow, suffer, or permit the generation, storage, use, treatment, or disposal of, any “hazardous waste” or “hazardous substance”

date_terms.label: Initial lease term
date_terms.original_text: for a term of five (5) years, commencing upon the date first listed above
date_terms.trigger: Execution date entered at the beginning of the lease

evidence.text: for a term of five (5) years, commencing upon the date first listed above

obligations.action: Pay Premises Rent to the City
obligations.recurrence: On or before the first day of each monthly term

evidence.text: The Premises Rent shall be paid on or before the first day of the term for which it is due.

obligations.action: Provide a valid certificate of insurance directly to the City
obligations.relative_deadline: Within ten business days after execution

evidence.text: Within ten (10) business days after execution of this Lease Agreement, a valid certificate of insurance verifying each of the coverages required above shall be issued directly to the City by the Lessee’s insurance agent of record or insurance company.
